1. (Currently amended) A humeral implant comprising a first component removably attached to a second component, __wherein the first component is a humeral surface component and the second component is a removably attached stem, and wherein the humeral surface component has a coronal radius of curvature and an axial radius of curvature, the coronal radius of curvature being different from the axial radius of curvature__.

2. (Currently amended) The humeral implant of claim 1 wherein said first component is a humeral surface __component__ and said second component is a removably attached stem.

3. (Currently amended) The implant of claim 2 wherein said humeral surface __component__ has a coronal radius of curvature and an axial radius of curvature, __said humeral surface component being elliptically shaped__.

9. (Currently amended) The implant of claim 3 wherein said humeral surface __component__ is [[spherically or]] elliptically shaped.

12. (Currently amended) The implant of claim 3 further comprising a concave undersurface __on said humeral surface component__ for bony ingrowth material.

13. (Currently amended) The implant of claim 3 wherein said humeral surface __component__ has a smooth articulating surface.

14. (Currently amended) The implant of claim 3 wherein said attachable stem has a diameter with a range of from 0.1 to 5.0 cm, __and wherein said attachable stem is made of a material selected from the group consisting of titanium, stainless steel, tantalum, porous metal and trabecular metal__.

15. (Currently amended) The implant of claim 14 wherein said attachable stem is made of a material selected from the group consisting of titanium, stainless steel, tantalum, porous metal and trabecular metal.

16. (Currently amended) The implant of claim 15 wherein said removably attached stem further comprises a smooth, textured or threaded surface, __and wherein said removably attached stem is round, square, or triangular__.

17. (Currently amended) The implant of claim 16 wherein said removably attached stem is round, square, or triangular.

20. (Currently amended) The implant of claim 2 wherein said removably attached stem has [[a variable]] __one of a plurality of different__ length__s__ wherein said stem extends from a lateral cortex of said humerus to a center of a head of said humerus.

21. (Currently amended) The implant of claim 2 wherein said humeral surface __component__ connects to said removably attached stem.

22. (Currently amended) The implant of claim 21 wherein said humeral surface __component__ connects to said removably attached stem by a technique selected from the group consisting of morse taper[[, and a screw]].

27. (Currently amended) A glenohumeral joint implant comprising an implant adapted to be implanted in a glenohumeral joint to provide a transhumeral portal along a central axis of a neck of a proximal humerus, __wherein the implant is a humeral implant__.

28. (Currently amended) The glenohumeral joint [[of claim 27 wherein said implant is a humeral implant]] __implant of claim 27__.

29. (Currently amended) A humerus bone implant comprising a modular implant with a humeral surface __component__ and a stem, wherein said stem is __adapted to be__ anchored in the epiphyseal-metaphyseal portion of said humerus bone, __and wherein said humeral surface component has a coronal radius of curvature and an axial radius of curvature, the humeral surface component being elliptically shaped__.

30. (Currently amended) The repaired humerus bone implant of claim 29 wherein said stem has a diameter with a range of from 0.1 to 5.0 cm, __and is made of a material selected from the group consisting of titanium, stainless steel, tantalum, porous metal and trabecular metal__.

31. (Currently amended) The repaired humerus bone implant of claim 30 wherein said stem is linear, __and has a smooth, textured or threaded surface__.
